// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul optimized via Weight Operand Caching.
void solution(void) {
  // Pre-format scale factor matrices to eliminate CPU-side staging in the hot loop
  static uint8_t A_scales_perf[BLOCKS_M][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];
  static uint8_t B_scales_perf[BLOCKS_N][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];

  // One-time pre-formatting before main loops start
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      
      // Only copy actual data, handle partial blocks correctly
      for (int i = 0; i < mrows; i++) {
        A_scales_perf[i0][g][i] = A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK + i];
      }
      // Pad with zeros for partial blocks if needed
      for (int i = mrows; i < BLK; i++) {
        A_scales_perf[i0][g][i] = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;
      
      // Only copy actual data, handle partial blocks correctly
      for (int j = 0; j < ncols; j++) {
        B_scales_perf[j0][g][j] = B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK + j];
      }
      // Pad with zeros for partial blocks if needed
      for (int j = ncols; j < BLK; j++) {
        B_scales_perf[j0][g][j] = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  // Configure execution once globally
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  int tiles_I = BLK / DIM;
  int tiles_J = BLK / DIM;
  int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
  uint32_t a_base = 0;
  uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_J * tiles_K * DIM;
  int SPAD_DEST = 0;

  // Outer loop: iterate over column blocks of B (weights)
  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; 
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; 
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;

    int tiles_J_actual = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM; // Round up to nearest tile
    
    // Load stationary B scale factors once per column block
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_perf[j0][0][0], sizeof(uint8_t) * (MATMUL_K / 32) * BLK, 1);

    // Load stationary B tiles into the upper half of the scratchpad
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t)); // B rows: stride N
    for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J_actual; j++) {
        int j_dim = (j == tiles_J_actual - 1 && ncols % DIM != 0) ? ncols % DIM : DIM;
        if (j_dim == 0) j_dim = DIM;
        gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                               b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, 
                               j_dim, DIM);
      }
    }

    // Inner loop: iterate over row blocks of A (activations)
    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; 
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; 
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      int tiles_I_actual = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM; // Round up to nearest tile
      int pad_i = tiles_I_actual * DIM - mrows;
      int pad_j = tiles_J_actual * DIM - ncols;

      // Load dynamic A scale factors
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_perf[i0][0][0], sizeof(uint8_t) * (MATMUL_K / 32) * BLK, 0);

      // Load dynamic A tiles into the lower half of the scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t)); // A rows: stride K
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I_actual; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          int i_dim = (i == tiles_I_actual - 1 && mrows % DIM != 0) ? mrows % DIM : DIM;
          if (i_dim == 0) i_dim = DIM;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, 
                                DIM, i_dim);
        }
      }

      // Configure store + MX requantizer
      gemmini_config_st(MATMUL_N * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I_actual, tiles_J_actual, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      
      // Perform computation utilizing the stationary B tiles and new A tiles
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I_actual, tiles_J_actual, tiles_K, 
                           pad_i/DIM, pad_j/DIM, 0, 
                           a_base, b_base, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Drain results to DRAM
      int out_rows = tiles_I_actual * DIM - pad_i;
      int out_cols = tiles_J_actual * DIM - pad_j;
      
      gemmini_config_st(MATMUL_N * sizeof(out_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < out_rows; i += DIM) {
        int rows_to_read = (i + DIM > out_rows) ? out_rows - i : DIM;
        gemmini_extended_mvout((void*)(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + i][j0 * BLK]),
                               SPAD_DEST + (i/DIM) * tiles_J_actual, 
                               out_cols, rows_to_read);
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
